# z8086 Notes

Imported from `https://github.com/nand2mario/z8086` at commit `596d9a6616b90c31f35b0d0947d4c1b11aa7a674` on 2026-05-05.

This directory contains z8086 structural-template and architectural-inspiration context only. z8086 does not authorize copying RTL into Keystone86, changing Keystone86 ownership boundaries, or importing z8086 instruction behavior as project scope.

z8086 does not widen or narrow Rung 6 scope. Rung 6 remains controlled by `docs/implementation/bringup/rung6.md` and Appendix D.

License/provenance status at import time: no standalone upstream `LICENSE`, `COPYING`, or `NOTICE` file was found at the fetched commit. The upstream README includes this license statement: "As for z8086 itself, I have chosen to release it under the permissive Apache 2.0 license."
